sub_site: amniotic fluid (amniocentesis and elective caesarean section)

evidence.quote: Virgen de Valme University Hospital (Seville, Spain)
First, shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed using a NovaSeq 6000 system
a 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing strategy was utilised

controls.types: sampling saline controls; blank extraction controls (DNA-free water); template-free PCR controls

evidence.quote: Sequence reads were obtained from negative extraction controls (EC1–4) with the PFP kit, and from negative PCR controls (PC1–4)
incorporation of sample-free DNA extraction controls in all nucleic acid extractions, and template-free PCR amplification controls
The only two species shared between the AF samples and negative controls were C. acnes and S. epidermidis

notes: 154 AF samples, 142 cultured; 16S on 18 (kit comparison) + 73 samples (91 total, per Lactobacillus '5/91'); shotgun on 5. Culture-only genera (Amycolatopsis, Cellulosimicrobium, Solibacillus, Paenibacillus, Brevundimonas) not recorded. C. acnes and S. epidermidis found in negative controls but authors argue biological; not removed. Exiguobacterium only in PCR controls (not recorded). Micrococcus/Cutibacterium/Staphylococcus cited from abstract (also culture); sequencing detection of these stated in E0049/E0050.
